title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-22 21:10 UTC — one stamp for all five cards.

A drain day: qlever-dir PR#15 merged 15:04 UTC, closing #14 (qlever-dir now 0 open issues, was 1). retinue#138 (mine) merged 16:22 UTC. PR#143, an omnibus fix, merged 17:49 UTC and closed 20 issues in one pass. retinue: 18 open (54 total), down sharply from the 08-21 23:15 stamp. One open PR org-wide, his own #148, already reviewed clean (bet-5).

Pages still stuck since 08-06 (16 d 7 h); served copies still 08-05 (17 d 2 h) — unaffected by today's drain.

1 star (owner's); 0 watchers; 1 fork. Traffic (14 d): 11 uniques, 139 views.

25 open issues across four repos; mine: 2 (retinue#67, chamber#10). Desk mostly a week+ old still; oldest chamber#1, 34 d 23 h.
